title: Add operator redaction profiles and KMS-origin fuse for region pinning
author: Elena Morozova
release_notes: Adds per-operator redaction profiles, KMS-origin binding for region pinning tokens, and a temporal RBAC circuit-breaker. No customer-facing API changes; opt-in rollout behind feature flag.
description: Motivation: Some compliance workflows require fine-grained declassification and redaction tied to operator activity, and strict proof that any region pinning decisions were made with a bona fide KMS-originated token. This PR introduces two complementary controls: 1) operator redaction profiles (declassification/redaction rules scoped per operator role and tenant) and 2) a KMS-origin fuse that attaches an origin-proof token to region-pin decisions and verification paths. Additionally, a temporal RBAC circuit-breaker is implemented to automatically throttle or downgrade operator elevation when suspicious audit patterns are detected.
detailed_summary: Summary of changes: - controller/authorization: add OperatorRedactionProfile CRD + validator and serializer (profiles include fields: redact_fields, retention_hints, allowed_declassifiers, ttl_seconds). - rbac/engine: implement temporal circuit-breaker that tracks elevation events per operator session and trips when anomaly windows exceed thresholds (configurable via admin config). - kms/origin: introduce KMS-origin-fuse component that verifies and mint a signed provenance token when a region-pin KMS call succeeds; tokens are short-lived and tied to KMS key ARN, request nonce, region, and operator identity. - audit/forwarder: enrich audit records with redaction-profile-id and kms-provenance-token; add downstream obfuscation hook used by our audit ingest pipeline. - api: add admin endpoints to preview redaction effects (dry-run) and to query circuit-breaker status. - console/ui: add small admin pages (hidden behind feature flag) to manage profiles and view tripping history. Implementation notes: KMS-origin-fuse uses existing KMS client wrappers and adds a small signing step using the platform service key; tokens are minted only after KMS policies confirm locality constraints. The redaction pipeline is deterministic and pluggable; default profiles are conservative to avoid accidental PII exposure. Rollout approach: feature-flagged in two stages: (1) backend-only dry-run mode where redactions are computed but not applied; (2) progressive enablement per account with canary tenants and monitor alerts for false positives. Backwards compatibility: existing RBAC policy model is unchanged; circuit-breaker is additional runtime guard and can be disabled per-cluster. No breaking API changes to public inference endpoints.

review_comments: Ayesha Khan: Nice separation of concerns. Two asks: add a short-circuit for tenants that already opt-out of auditable redaction to avoid perf overhead, and ensure the KMS-origin token does not leak into customer payloads.
Author (Elena): Addressed. Added tenant opt-out flag and ensured token is only recorded into internal audit headers and obfuscator. Updated tests to cover header scrub.

Daniel Park: Circuit-breaker looks good, but the trip thresholds should be configurable via configmap AND via console. Also, add a Prometheus metric for 'breaker_tripped_total' with tags for operator role and tenant.
Author (Elena): Added configmap binding and console toggle. Added metrics: breaker_tripped_total and breaker_cooldown_seconds.
Marcus Liu: Security review — the KMS-origin token uses the platform signing key; who rotates that key? We should document key rotation and fallback if signing service is unavailable.
Author (Elena): Added documentation section 'Key rotation and failure modes' and fallback logic to allow verification using cached public keys for up to 5 minutes while rotation completes.
ci: security-scan: pass (minor telemetry dependency flagged; accepted)
qa_notes: QA validated dry-run against three canary tenants with mixed data residency settings; no PII removal observed in dry-run (expected). Verified that KMS-origin tokens are present in internal audit headers and absent from external responses. Verified circuit-breaker tripping in simulated anomaly window and automatic cooldown behavior.
rollout_plan: 1) Deploy backend behind feature flag (dry-run) to staging and run canary tenants. 2) Monitor metrics for false positives and performance impact for 72h. 3) Enable profile application for 10% tenants, monitor. 4) Gradually expand to 100% with weekly reviews. Emergency rollback path: disable feature flag and revert configmap; audit pipeline still stores raw events.
notes: This PR introduces an opt-in compliance surface; security and SRE signed off. Follow-on work planned: automated policy generator from sample prompt sets and expanded KMS multi-provider proofing.
